articles.title: BitGo secures South Korea virtual asset license, says it's the first global crypto company to do so
articles.snippet: Backed by Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom, BitGo Korea built a locally registered entity from scratch to serve institutional and enterprise clients, rather than taking the acquisition route.

articles.title: Trump Says AI Could Be 'Bigger Than the Internet' as He Pushes Light-Touch Regulation
articles.snippet: The president said the U.S. is far ahead of China in artificial intelligence and defended the rapid construction of data centers and power plants needed to fuel the industry.
